package external.nodus.compat;

import edu.uclouvain.core.nodus.NodusMapPanel;
import edu.uclouvain.core.nodus.NodusPlugin;
import edu.uclouvain.core.nodus.NodusProject;
import edu.uclouvain.core.nodus.tools.console.NodusConsole;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Properties;

/** Compiled against the original API; tests load the resulting JAR without recompiling it. */
public class LegacyExtension extends NodusPlugin {
  @Override
  public Properties getProperties() {
    Properties properties = new Properties();
    properties.setProperty(USER_DEFINED_MENUBAR_TEXT, "Compatibility");
    properties.setProperty(MENU_ITEM__TEXT, "Legacy extension");
    return properties;
  }

  @Override
  public void execute() {
    NodusMapPanel panel = getNodusMapPanel();
    NodusProject project = panel.getNodusProject();
    HashMap<String, Object> objects = panel.getStoredObjects();
    objects.put("legacy.project", project);
    panel.storeObject("legacy.styles", project.getStyleProperties());
    panel.storeObject("legacy.consoleVisible", NodusConsole.isVisible());
    project.getOtherNodeNumbers().put(42, 42);
    panel.storeObject("legacy.nodeIds", project.getOtherNodeNumbers());
    panel.startProgress(2);
    panel.updateProgress("Legacy extension", 1);
    panel.stopProgress();
  }

  @Override
  public void dispose() {
    getNodusMapPanel().storeObject("legacy.disposed", true);
    Integer count = (Integer) getNodusMapPanel().retrieveObject("legacy.disposeCount");
    getNodusMapPanel().storeObject("legacy.disposeCount", count == null ? 1 : count + 1);
    super.dispose();
  }

  /** Uses the protected constructor and overrides used by existing subclasses. */
  public static class Panel extends NodusMapPanel {
    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
    private final NodusProject project = new NodusProject(this);

    public Panel() {
      super();
    }

    @Override
    public NodusProject getNodusProject() {
      return project;
    }

    @Override
    public void setBusy(boolean value) {
      storeObject("legacy.busy", value);
    }

    @Override
    public void resetText() {
      storeObject("legacy.resetText", true);
    }
  }
}
